2. The App

MigraineKit is a diary. You can log a migraine that is happening now, or one from an earlier day, mark it Soft, Strong, or Severe, and note whether you took medicine. You can look back at the list, and with Pro you can see a chart, export a one-page PDF, and open the sounds other than white noise.
3. Not medical advice

MigraineKit stores what you typed. It does not diagnose, predict, score risk, or suggest treatment. It is not a medical device. Talk to a doctor about your migraines. If you need urgent help, contact a doctor or local emergency services.

6. Free use and Pro

You can save three entries for free. Deleting an entry does not give that free save back. MigraineKit Pro unlocks unlimited entries, the chart, the PDF, and every sound except white noise, which stays free. Pro is either a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase. There is no monthly plan and no free trial. Prices are shown in the App before you pay.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase.
The yearly plan renews unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Apple charges the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends, at the price shown in the App Store.
You can manage or cancel the yearly plan in your Apple ID account settings.
The lifetime purchase is paid once and does not renew.
7. Your entries
What you type stays yours. It stays on the iPhone where you typed it. Uninstalling MigraineKit, or deleting an entry, removes it from that iPhone. We do not keep a copy.
